goal: Add global overlays, keyboard shortcuts, and final integration polish.
summary: Phase 7 completed after grader feedback. Added three new e2e specs in e2e/global-overlays.spec.ts covering: (1) Spotlight opens via Cmd+Space, filters apps, and opens a window; (2) Control Center opens from the menu bar and shows glass panel, toggles, and sliders; (3) menu-bar app menu and standard menus render mocked dropdowns. Fixed the Spotlight app-selection bug by checking for the app 'category' property instead of the non-existent 'appId'. Extracted contexts/hooks to satisfy oxlint's fast-refresh rules with zero warnings. Final verification: npm run lint 0 warnings/0 errors, npm test 84 unit tests pass, npm run build succeeds, npm run test:e2e 15 tests pass.
stepSummaries:
